test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Seven people, V, F, D, S, R, C, and P are sitting in a straight line, facing south. Only two people sit between V and P. Only two people sit to the right of V. D sits third to the left of S. P is an immediate neighbour of D and F. C is an immediate neighbour of S.

Total how many people sit between S and P?
solution:
According to the given information, seven people, V, F, D, S, R, C, and P are sitting in a straight line, facing south

 
• Only two people sit to the right of V which means V is sitting third from the right end of the row.
 
• Only two people sit between V and P which means P will sit to the left of V. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37b35f1018ebe54b7de772c73d80d28222b7772a88bdd9d06d56580b3196f8c5.png] 
 
• P is an immediate neighbour of D and F
 
• D sits third to the left of S.

There will be two cases, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a5c2ba501cfa51c18b0789496e3fc9c735de80e961d1b680f0b6b4ea0b0978c.png] 

 
• C is an immediate neighbour of S. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c4d646ac881b5a16f5bb2fc8f5b60df940621fc9b47bf17a20d5af4cf444eae.png] 

In case 1, there is no place for C to sit immediate neighbour of S. And R will sit between V and D.

So, we will go with only case 2. 

The final arrangement is as follows, [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b4b267e84a7ed05727bd96275f346b3375854a0d4085fe4633764ac3e672cb1.png] 

**Hence, Three people sit between S and P.**
